# Tavily test fixtures

SYNTHETIC. These are shaped like Tavily's documented `/search` and `/extract` answers but were written by hand for
the tests: they are not recordings of live calls. (The live API could not be reached with the owner's key when
this was built: it answered `403 Forbidden` from the CDN.) Company names and domains in them are invented or are
used only as examples of "a different company"; no test sends to any of them.
